content: @webext-core/messaging (by WXT's own author, aklinker1) provides defineExtensionMessaging<ProtocolMap>() returning typed sendMessage/onMessage helpers usable from content scripts, background, and popup -- WXT's official messaging guide (wxt.dev/guide/essentials/messaging) recommends this as the standard wrapper over raw browser.runtime.sendMessage/onMessage to avoid ad-hoc message-shape drift. This directly matches CONTEXT.md D-09's 'typed contract layer' requirement.
